name: glissa
description: Glissa's own design docs, for an agent working on this repo.
rules: Server code is CommonJS only; frontend code is ES modules bundled by Vite.
Status detection is structural (Claude Code hooks plus the OSC-0 title fallback); never scrape the rendered terminal body.
Pure logic lives in a core module, IO in a thin shell around it.
Read AGENTS.md in the repo root before changing anything; it is the canonical architecture doc.
